class.name: simport/BinaryCodec
class.description: Binary packets described field by field in YAML, with an optional envelope.

class.name: simport/SerialPty
class.description: Emulated serial port backed by a pseudo-terminal.

class.name: simport/TextCodec
class.description: ASCII frames from a template, e.g. NMEA 0183 sentences.

class.name: simport/FixedRate
class.description: Emit the latest record at a fixed device rate on the device clock.

class.name: simport/Bandwidth
class.description: Model a finite line rate; drop frames on transmit overrun.

class.name: simport/OnRequest
class.description: Never emit on its own; send only as the answer of a service.

class.name: simport/Delimiter
class.description: Frames ending in a delimiter, e.g. text lines.

class.name: simport/SyncLength
class.description: Binary frames starting with a sync pattern and carrying their length.

class.name: simport/TcpServer
class.description: Emulated network device accepting TCP connections.

class.name: simport/Http
class.description: HTTP/1.x messages delimited by their header and Content-Length.

class.name: simport/HttpCodec
class.description: HTTP/1.1 requests (decode) and responses (encode) for device web APIs.

class.name: simport/SocketCan
class.description: Emulated devices on a (virtual) CAN bus through Linux SocketCAN, CAN and CAN-FD.
